scenes: How to read a heat headline.
Which measure? Air temperature, heat index and WBGT are different numbers. | Confirmed, or suspected? The counts can be far apart. | Who said it, and how do they know? | And what happened next?
The news here refreshes automatically, | and every headline is kept, with its link, in our sources.
Read the heat, not just the headline.
